verdict.rationale: Unity officially documents command-line/editor CLI args, headless mode (-batchmode/-nographics), and BuildSettings/build profiles for automated builds, which together enable scripted, non-interactive CI builds; Unity Hub can be installed headlessly via package managers. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on CI pipeline report confirming end-to-end success, and community evidence notes real friction with setting up CI/build servers due to licensing costs.
